EmailTemplate.name: Sustainability MS App Received
EmailTemplate.subject: ASU Sustainability MS Application Received
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your application to the MS program in the School of Sustainability at Arizona State University for the fall 2015 semester.
You should have received an automated email from ASU Graduate Admissions with instructions on setting up your My ASU account. In My ASU, you can monitor the status of the following items:
Your official transcripts English Proficiency requirements (if applicable) Your letters of recommendation
The "Manage Recommenders" feature allows you to view details on which letters are still missing. You can send an email reminder (once every seven days) to your recommenders.
We must have all materials by Dec. 15, 2014 to consider your application including GRE scores (if applicable). We will send you an email once your application file is complete. Then, we will notify you of our decision in early February.
Please contact the Sustainability advising office at 480-727-6963 or SOSGradAdvising@asu.edu if you have any questions.
Regards,
Katerina Kinast Graduate Academic Success Coordinator P.O. Box 875502 | Tempe, Arizona | 85287-5502 PH: 480-965-5923 | Main: 480-727-6963
